studies.label: Mac-development
studies.history: Original42series development partition, previously studied. No unseen-data claim. New algorithm derived without these runtime outcomes.
studies.primary_criterion: Parity on every case; at L=30 geometric and aggregate ratio lower95% family-cluster bootstrap bounds above1 against every eight comparator methods. This is a scoped empirical criterion, not a global firstness or acceptance determination.
studies.scope: Independent receipt/statistical reconstruction, not independent metric recomputation or hardware attestation. Fastest-control oracle selects the fastest of all eight controls separately for each case after measurement. Work reductions count support visits and do not imply equal wall-time reductions. Family-bootstrap intervals do not quantify machine-population or timing-repeat uncertainty.
